smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: HomeDesigns AI
shortDescription: Redesigns a room photo and turns a flat floor plan into a 3D view. Standard is $22 a month.
longDescription: HomeDesigns AI redesigns a photo of a room, an exterior, or a garden, and it also turns a flat floor plan into a furnished 3D view. Standard is $22 a month, or $9 a month billed yearly, for 100 design credits. Pro is $29 a month, or $11 a month billed yearly, for 1,000 credits. Expert is $37 a month, or $14 a month billed yearly, for 2,000 credits. Each paid plan lists 2D to 3D floor plans.
pricingNotes: Standard is $22 per month or $9 per month billed yearly for 100 credits. Pro is $29 per month or $11 per month billed yearly for 1,000 credits. Expert is $37 per month or $14 per month billed yearly for 2,000 credits.
bestFor: A room photo that should become an interior redesign

notIdealFor: A blueprint photo when you need the walls locked to the drawing
